patch_description: This uses a sparse, shadow-price approach rather than rewarding every possible two-hop path. It estimates how contested each directed link and relay node is from the demand matrix, then gives each OD pair’s two-hop reward only to its two most promising relays. Candidate paths are preferred when their links and relay appear less loaded, while direct-link rewards retain demand-sensitive value. The sparse couplings reduce interaction clutter and discourage the surrogate from treating every possible detour as equally useful.
